def transforms(p):
    n=len(p)
    res=[]
    # identity
    res.append(p)
    # row complement
    res.append([n-1 - r for r in p])
    # column reversal
    res.append(p[::-1])
    # column reversal + row complement

    # also maybe reflect across main diagonal: take inverse permutation (position of each row)
    inv=[0]*n

        inv[r]=c
    res.append(inv)

    # inv then column reversal
    res.append(inv[::-1])
    # inv then both
    res.append([n-1 - r for r in inv[::-1]])
    return res
